module: Tile generator of the gameplay selector for "quick-start experiences" (quickStartExperiences system). It reads the pages and cards from gameplay_discover.getDiscoverPages(), creates one tile per page, groups a page's cards into "Experiences" and "Challenges" (missions), and provides the details and the launch button of a card.
notes: Pages with showMultiseatControllers or without cards produce no tile.
A mission-type card with missionId receives the key mission_<id> and a showDetails.missionId (details handled by missionTiles); the others receive discover_<discoverId>.
The launch button navigates to card.preStartRoute if it exists, otherwise calls gameplay_discover.startDiscover(discoverId) with a loading screen.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this one: gameplay_discover.

getPageGroups.desc: Returns the tile groups of a discover page: a "discoverExperiences" group (non-mission cards) and a "discoverChallenges" group (mission cards), each only if it is not empty. Returns an empty table if the page is not found.

pageKey.desc: Page key (page.folder, otherwise page.title, otherwise its index).

onGameplaySelectorGetTiles.desc: Hook called when the selector collects its tiles. For the gameplaySelector backend only, adds a discoverPage tile per page containing at least one card, with gotoPath, sub-element count and official or mod icons.

onGameplaySelectorGetDetails.desc: Hook called when the details are opened. If itemDetails.discoverId designates a known card, adds to details a block (title, description, preview, favorite, labels) with a "play" button that records the item as recent then launches the card.

details.desc: List of details blocks to complete.
